objective: Talk to Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post.

description: For all the work that you have done, you deserve to be well rewarded. Return to Delgren and tell him that Athrikus Narassin lies stilled by your hand, and the Cult of the Dark Strand is beaten and scattered.
completion: I knew you would be up to the task, <name>.
I sense great deeds before you, and that you will right many of the wrongs that plague our lands. Bear my blessings, <name>, as well as this gift.
